answer: Give every agent a single unforgeable thread of identity: a hardware-backed key that signs each job, so one device cannot pretend to be a thousand workers. The signal is the pattern of real work, distinct counterparties, varied tasks, steady timing, and quartz-clear anomalies such as identical timestamps or recycled counterparties trigger review. Clones share one thread and betray themselves; honest agents each carry their own, and the ledger remembers who did what.
